app.busy_close: Cannot quit while working. Cancel first, then close.
app.not_admin: ⚠ No administrator rights. Run as administrator to format or clone.
app.title: FastFAT — FAT32 formatter / disk cloning
clone.confirm_expand: Grows FAT32 and moves the other partitions to the end.
clone.confirm_overwrite: All data on Disk {disk} (every partition) will be overwritten. Continue?
clone.confirm_verbatim: Copies sector by sector as is.
clone.confirm_wiiu: Grows FAT32 and creates an empty Wii U storage area ({gib} GiB) at the end.
clone.intro: Writes the contents of the source disk to the destination disk.
clone.layout_expand: Grow FAT32 (other partitions are copied as is to the end)
clone.layout_verbatim: Copy as is (sector by sector, same size as the source)
clone.layout_wiiu: For Wii U (grow FAT32 + empty Wii U storage area)
clone.new_signature: Give the destination a new disk signature (prevents Windows from taking it offline on a collision)
clone.same_disk: Source and destination are the same disk.
clone.sector_mismatch: The logical sector sizes differ, so partition positions cannot be kept.
clone.storage_too_big: The Wii U storage area is not smaller than the destination.
clone.system_disk: Cannot write to the Windows system disk.
clone.too_small: The destination is smaller than the source.
clone.wiiu_note1: FAT32 files (Aroma, ROMs, ...) are copied. The Wii U storage area is created empty;
clone.wiiu_note2: the Wii U formats it itself when it asks after being plugged in (FAT32 is kept).
format.confirm_erase: All data will be erased. Continue?
format.confirm_mbr: Initialises the whole Disk {disk} (every partition) as MBR.
format.fixed_warning: ⚠ A fixed drive is selected. Double-check the target.
format.gpt_warning: ⚠ The Wii U / vWii cannot read GPT disks. Enable "Wii U compatible".
format.label: Volume label:
format.quick: Quick format (do not zero the data area)
format.wiiu: Wii U compatible (initialise the whole disk as MBR + FAT32)
format.wiiu_cluster: ⚠ Clusters of 32 KiB or less are recommended for the Wii U
format.wiiu_note: Deletes every partition on the disk and creates one primary partition. Up to 2 TiB.
ftp.connect_failed:
{err}
Check that ftpiiu is enabled on the Wii U and that the IP address is correct.
ftp.only_new_hint: Checked as each file's turn comes: files of the same size are skipped as already downloaded; others are replaced.
ftp.overwrite_hint: Downloads every file again, replacing what is on the PC.
ftp.read_only: 🔒 Read-only mode (Wii U → PC downloads only; no FTP command that writes is ever sent)
ftp.setup1: 1. Enable the ftpiiu plugin (ftpiiu.wps) in the Aroma environment.
ftp.setup2: 2. To see the internal memory (console updates etc.), open the plugin settings with L + D-pad down + −
ftp.setup3: and enable "Allow access to system files" of ftpiiu (off by default).
ftp.setup4: 3. Connect the Wii U and the PC to the same LAN, enter the Wii U's IP address and press "Connect".
ftp.setup5: The IP is shown in the Wii U's internet connection status or in the router's admin page.
ftp.setup6: 4. Do not let the Wii U sleep during transfers.
ftp.system_files_hint: To see the internal memory or USB, enable "Allow access to system files" in ftpiiu.
ftp.workers_hint: Number of FTP connections used at once. The console is the bottleneck, so 1 is usually fastest (measured: 0.61 MiB/s with 1, 0.48 MiB/s with 4).
job.cancelled_clone: Cancelled. The contents of Disk {destination} are incomplete.
job.cancelled_copy: Cancelled. The partial file was removed; files copied before it remain.
job.cancelled_format: Cancelled. {letter}: is not formatted; format it again.
job.cloned_next: Plug it into the Wii U and accept when it asks to format the USB storage (FAT32 is kept).
pane.local_hint: Drop Wii U items here to copy them into the folder shown.
pane.open_destination_left: Open the destination folder on the PC side (left).
pane.remote_hint: Double-click (or click a selected row) to open. Drag to the PC side on the left to copy.
transfer.failures: Failed: {count} (downloaded again automatically at the end)
